articles.title: Node-based design tool Flora raises $42M from Redpoint Ventures
articles.summary: Flora lets customers use image, text, or video to create media assets, including images and video. Users can also use prompts to create modifications to build new nodes with multiple iterations. These generated versions are mapped with each other on a canvas to give you a tractable flow of creation.

articles.title: ‘Among the worst we’ve seen’: report slams xAI’s Grok over child safety failures

articles.summary: The unprecedented scale and speed of AI data center demand requires institutional rather than technical innovation, University of Texas at Austin's Michael Webber said.

articles.title: GHG Protocol proposal risks slowing clean energy expansion
articles.summary: Proposed changes to the Greenhouse Gas Protocol would make it more difficult for companies to report renewables use and could discourage procurement, according Lesley Hunter and Jeffrey Gorham of the American Council on Renewable Energy.

articles.title: In 2026, virtual power plants must scale or risk being left behind
articles.summary: The AI data center frenzy is shifting utilities’ focus to large-scale generation. But advocates say flexible, distributed energy resources still provide the biggest bang for the buck, according to our 2026 DER outlook.

articles.title: MISO regulators seek stakeholder review for DOE ‘emergency’ orders cost allocation

articles.title: Arabelle turbines selected for Polish plant
articles.summary: EDF subsidiary Arabelle Solutions has been selected by Bechtel and Westinghouse to supply half-speed Arabelle steam turbine and generator sets for the three AP1000 units planned at Poland's first nuclear power plant.

articles.title: German steam generators arrive in Sweden for recycling
articles.summary: EDF subsidiary Cyclife Sweden AB has completed the transfer of the four steam generators from Germany's shut down Unterweser nuclear power plant to its facility in Nyköping, Sweden, for processing.

articles.title: Namibia discusses nuclear energy cooperation with Russia
articles.summary: Namibia’s Foreign and Trade Minister Selma Ashipala-Musavyi has held talks in Moscow about growing cooperation in a number of areas, including nuclear energy.

articles.title: Ukraine and Poland discuss Khmelnitsky expansion plans
articles.summary: Talks about any potential cross-border environmental impact issues from the proposed two AP1000 units at the Khmelnitsky Nuclear Power Plant have taken place with Poland and "expert consultations completed", Ukraine’s Ministry of Economy, Environment and Agriculture has said.

articles.title: Leningrad 4 given five-year life extension licence
articles.summary: Russian nuclear regulator Rostekhnadzor has approved a five-year life extension for Leningrad nuclear power plant’s unit 4 - which will take the RBMK-1000 reactor to 50 years of operation.

articles.title: Skanska to produce prototype aseismic bearing for Rolls-Royce SMR
articles.summary: Rolls-Royce SMR has contracted Skanska UK to deliver an aseismic bearing pedestal demonstrator for its small modular reactor. These structural isolation devices are a key part of the factory-built nuclear power plant's design.

articles.title: Long-term graphite agreement strengthens X-energy supply chain
articles.summary: The 10-year framework agreement between X-energy Reactor Company and SGL Carbon LLC covers the supply of graphite for the deployment of X-energy's Xe-100 small modular reactor, with a contract to support the first deployment of the reactor at the Seadrift site in Texas and an agreement to reserve capacity for a planned 12-unit plant in Washington S

articles.title: Licensing of Newcleo's SMR progresses in France
articles.summary: Innovative reactor developer Newcleo has submitted the safety options dossier for its lead-cooled fast neutron reactor to the French Nuclear Safety and Radiation Protection Authority.

articles.title: NASA, DOE aim for nuclear reactor on moon by 2030
articles.summary: The US government space and energy agencies have renewed their commitment to work together to develop a fission power source for use on the surface of the Moon and future missions to Mars.

articles.title: New York governor sets out vision for nuclear backbone
articles.summary: The Nuclear Reliability Backbone initiative unveiled by Kathy Hochul in her annual State of the State address includes plans for 4 GWe of new nuclear capacity in addition to plans for 1 GWe announced last year.

articles.title: China starts construction of innovative nuclear project
articles.summary: First concrete has been poured for the nuclear island of unit 1 at Phase I of the Xuwei nuclear power project in China's Jiangsu province. The plant will supply both industrial heating and electricity by coupling a high-temperature gas-cooled reactor with two Hualong One pressurised water reactors.

articles.title: Project Phoenix report backs SMR use in Slovakia
articles.summary: A feasibility study carried out as part of the USA's Project Phoenix scheme has backed the suitability of small modular reactors in the Slovak Republic.

articles.title: National targets for new nuclear 'far exceed a tripling of global capacity'
articles.summary: Global generating capacity could reach 1,446 GWe by 2050 if governments hit their targets for new nuclear, far exceeding the 1,200 GWe goal set in the Declaration to Triple Nuclear Energy, according to a new World Nuclear Association report.

articles.title: Joint study validates SMR use for chemical plants
articles.summary: A two-year study by Oak Ridge National Laboratory and NuScale looked at the performance and profitability of coupling a NuScale Power Module with a US chemical facility to provide nuclear-generated steam and electric power - and shows pairing NuScale's nuclear technology with a heat augmentation system to be both profitable and reliable.

articles.title: Slovakia and USA sign nuclear energy agreement
articles.summary: Slovakia's Prime Minister Robert Fico and US Energy Secretary Chris Wright have signed an Intergovernmental Agreement to advance the European country's nuclear power programme, including deploying a new 1,200 MWe unit.

articles.title: UK maritime nuclear consortium launched
articles.summary: Lloyd's Register is leading a new consortium of UK companies seeking "to set the highest international standards for safe, secure and commercially viable nuclear-powered ships".

articles.title: Rosatom hopes for four foreign unit start-ups in 2026
articles.summary: The first nuclear units in Bangladesh and Turkey, plus ones at Tianwan and Xudabao in China could all start-up during 2026, according to Rosatom Director General Alexei Likhachev.

articles.title: Dioxitek celebrates record UO2 production
articles.summary: Argentina's state-owned producer of uranium dioxide set a new production record in 2025, which it says means it is possible to meet the needs of the country's nuclear power plants domestically.

articles.title: Tepco delays restart of Kashiwazaki-Kariwa reactor
articles.summary: Tokyo Electric Power Company has reportedly postponed the scheduled 20 January restart of unit 6 at its Kashiwazaki-Kariwa nuclear power plant after a safety alarm failed to sound during pre-reactor start-up checks.

articles.title: Amentum to be delivery partner for Rolls-Royce SMR
articles.summary: Amentum has been appointed as programme delivery partner for Rolls-Royce SMR small modular reactor projects, beginning with those in the UK and the Czech Republic.
